title: 2023 AMC 12B Problem 2
statement: Carlos went to a sports store to buy running shoes. Running shoes were on sale, with prices reduced by \(20\%\) on every pair of shoes. Carlos also knew that he had to pay a \(7.5\%\) sales tax on the discounted price. He had \(43\) dollars. What is the original (before discount) price of the most expensive shoes he could afford to buy?

solutions.text:
The final cost of a pair with original price \(p\) is \(0.8\times 1.075\times p=0.86p.\) Setting \(0.86p\le 43\) gives \(p\le 50,\) so the most expensive affordable pair originally cost \(50\) dollars.

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: A \(20\%\) discount multiplies the price by \(0.8,\) then the \(7.5\%\) tax multiplies by \(1.075\)
Solve \(0.8\times 1.075\times p\le 43\) for the largest original price \(p\)
